Pet Toxicity: Will make them sick (Oral irritation, vomiting)
Care Instructions:
Light: Bright, indirect light.
Humidity: High (60%+).
Soil: Chunky aroid mix.
Tips: Wipe leaves monthly. Water every 7-10 days.
Propagation Instructions: Identify a node. Cut below it and root in water or sphagnum moss.

Care Instructions:
Light: Low/medium indirect light.
Humidity: Very high.
Watering: Keep soil moist. Water every 4-7 days.
Propagation Instructions: Best via rhizome division. Gently pull apart at the roots during repotting.

Care Instructions:
Light: 6+ hours sun for color.
Soil: Gritty cactus mix.
Warning: Susceptible to rot. Water every 14-21 days.
Propagation Instructions: Twist off a leaf. Callous for 2 days, then place on top of dry soil. Do not water until roots appear.

Care Instructions:
Light: Bright indirect light.
Watering: Use 'soak and dry' method. Water every 10-14 days.
Propagation Instructions: Take a 3-5 inch stem cutting. Strip bottom 'bananas' and bury stem in soil.

Care Instructions:
Light: Very bright indirect light.
Note: Never prune the flower stalks (peduncles). Water every 10-14 days.
Propagation Instructions: Take a cutting with two nodes. Root in water or damp perlite.

Pet Toxicity: Will make them sick (Vomiting, slow heart rate)
Care Instructions:
Light: Full sun.
Pruning: Pinch growth for a tree shape. Water every 14-21 days.
Propagation Instructions: Use stem cuttings. Let the cut end dry/callous for 3-5 days before planting.

Pet Toxicity: Will make them sick (Vomiting, heart rhythm issues)
Care Instructions:
Light: Bright light.
Bloom Care: Deadhead spent flowers. Water every 10-14 days.
Propagation Instructions: Take stem tip cuttings. Let dry for 24 hours, then plant in moist, sandy soil.

Care Instructions:
Light: Filtered light.
Environment: Tropical; needs humidity and cool nights to bloom. Water every 7-10 days.
Propagation Instructions: Twist off 3 segments. Let dry for 1 day. Stand upright in moist cactus soil.

Care Instructions:
Light: Intense light for red edges.
Care: Avoid water in the rosette. Water every 14-21 days.
Propagation Instructions: Snip off 'pups' (offsets) that grow at the base and re-plant.

Care Instructions:
Light: Full sun for burgundy color.
Growth: Leggy gaps mean more light needed. Water every 10-14 days.
Propagation Instructions: Stem snips. Remove bottom leaves to expose stem and plant in dry soil.

Care Instructions:
Light: Highly adaptable.
Water: Sensitive to fluoride (brown tips). Water every 7 days.
Propagation Instructions: Snip the spiderette (baby) from the runner and root in water.

Care Instructions:
Light: Bright indirect to keep curls tight.
Care: Great for hanging baskets. Water every 7 days.
Propagation Instructions: Remove the curly plantlets from runners and root in water or soil.

Care Instructions:
Light: Bright, indirect light.
Watering: Avoid moving often. Water every 7-10 days.
Propagation Instructions: Take stem cuttings with two nodes. Use a humidity dome for best results.

Care Instructions:
Light: Low/medium.
Humidity: Needs 60-90%.
Warning: Will wilt flat when dry. Water every 3-5 days.
Propagation Instructions: Snip a 2-inch stem cutting. Roots quickly in water or moist soil.

Care Instructions:
Light: Medium to bright indirect.
Note: Better to underwater than overwater. Water every 7-10 days.
Propagation Instructions: Propagate from a single leaf. Cut leaf in half and stick cut edge into soil.

Care Instructions:
Light: Low/medium indirect.
Water: Distilled or rain water only. Water every 5-7 days.
Propagation Instructions: Must use root division. Gently separate clumps during repotting.
